build_norm_ema_vector_quantizer: build a NormEMAVectorQuantizer module with 8192 embeddings and 32 dimensions for vector quantization
create_embedding_ema: create an EmbeddingEMA codebook with k-means initialization for a given number of tokens and dimensions
run_kmeans_initialization: run k-means clustering on sample vectors to initialize codebook embedding weights
